description_en: Queries the feature configurations of a site. You can query all feature configurations of a site or specify a feature name to query a specific feature configuration
description_zh: 查询站点功能配置，可以查询站点下所有的功能配置，也可以传FunctionName指定查询某一项功能配置
name: ListSiteFunctions

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global configurations or rule configurations. Valid values:
global: Queries global configurations.
rule: Queries rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, both global and rule configurations are queried. This parameter takes effect only when the FunctionName parameter is specified
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：
global：查询全局配置；
rule：查询规则配置；

该参数可以不传，不传时不区分全局或者规则配置。此参数只有在传了functionName参数时才会生效
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The rule name. You can use this parameter to query the rule whose name matches the specified value. This parameter takes effect only when the FunctionName parameter is specified
parameters.help_zh: 规则名，可以查出规则名为所传字段的那条规则，只有传了functionName才生效
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 500. Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页几条，最大500，不传时默认500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

Configs.description_en: The configurations in the response body

Enable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable cache reserve. Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
Enable.description_zh:
是否开启缓存保持，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

AdditionalCacheablePorts.description_en: The ports on which the caching feature is enabled. Valid values: 8880, 2052, 2082, 2086, 2095, 2053, 2083, 2087, and 2096

BrowserCacheMode.description_en:
The browser cache mode. Valid values:
no_cache: No caching.
follow_origin: Follow the origin server cache policy.
override_origin: Override the origin server cache policy
BrowserCacheMode.description_zh:
浏览器缓存模式。取值范围：
no_cache：不缓存。
follow_origin：遵循源站缓存策略。
override_origin：代替源站缓存策略

BrowserCacheTtl.description_en: The browser cache expiration time, in seconds
BrowserCacheTtl.description_zh: 浏览器缓存过期时间，单位是秒

BypassCache.description_en:
The bypass cache mode. Valid values:
cache_all: All requests are cached.
bypass_all: All requests bypass the cache
BypassCache.description_zh:
设置绕过缓存模式。取值范围：
cache_all：所有请求都缓存。
bypass_all：所有请求都绕过缓存

CacheDeceptionArmor.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable cache deception armor. This feature defends against web cache deception attacks by caching only verified content. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
CacheDeceptionArmor.description_zh:
缓存欺骗防御。用于防御Web缓存欺骗攻击，通过校验的缓存内容才会被缓存下来。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

CacheReserveEligibility.description_en:
The cache reserve eligibility. This parameter controls whether user requests bypass cache reserve nodes when being routed to the origin server. Valid values:
bypass_cache_reserve: Requests bypass cache reserve.
eligible_for_cache_reserve: Requests are eligible for cache reserve
CacheReserveEligibility.description_zh:
缓存保持资格。用于控制用户请求在回源的时候是否绕过缓存保持节点。取值范围：
bypass_cache_reserve：请求绕过缓存保持。
eligible_for_cache_reserve：符合缓存保持资格

CheckPresenceCookie.description_en: The cookie names to check for presence when generating cache keys. If a cookie exists, its name is added to the cache key. Cookie names are case-insensitive. You can specify multiple cookie names separated by spaces
CheckPresenceCookie.description_zh: 生成缓存键的时候，检查cookie是否存在，如果存在，则在缓存键中加入cookie名称（cookie名称不区分大小写）。支持输入多个cookie名称，多个值之间用空格分隔

CheckPresenceHeader.description_en: The header names to check for presence when generating cache keys. If a header exists, its name is added to the cache key. Header names are case-insensitive. You can specify multiple header names separated by spaces
CheckPresenceHeader.description_zh: 生成缓存键的时候，检查header是否存在，如果存在，则在缓存键中加入header名称（header名称不区分大小写）。支持输入多个header名称，多个值之间用空格分隔

EdgeCacheMode.description_en:
The edge node cache mode. Valid values:
follow_origin: Follow the origin server cache policy if it exists. Otherwise, use the default cache policy.
no_cache: No caching.
override_origin: Override the origin server cache policy.
follow_origin_bypass: Follow the origin server cache policy if it exists. Otherwise, do not cache
EdgeCacheMode.description_zh:
节点缓存模式。取值范围：
follow_origin：遵循源站缓存策略（如果存在），否则使用默认缓存策略。
no_cache：不缓存。
override_origin：代替源站缓存策略。
follow_origin_bypass：遵循源站缓存策略（如果存在），否则不缓存

EdgeCacheTtl.description_en: The edge node cache expiration time, in seconds
EdgeCacheTtl.description_zh: 节点缓存过期时间，单位是秒

EdgeStatusCodeCacheTtl.description_en: The status code cache expiration time, in seconds
EdgeStatusCodeCacheTtl.description_zh: 状态码缓存过期时间，单位是秒

IncludeCookie.description_en: The cookie names and their values to be included when generating cache keys. You can specify multiple values separated by spaces
IncludeCookie.description_zh: 生成缓存键的时候，包括指定的cookie名称及其值，支持输入多个值，多个值之间用空格分隔

IncludeHeader.description_en: The header names and their values to be included when generating cache keys. You can specify multiple values separated by spaces
IncludeHeader.description_zh: 生成缓存键的时候，包括指定的标头名称及其值，支持输入多个值，多个值之间用空格分隔

PostBodySizeLimit.description_en: The body size limit, in KB. Valid values are 1 to 8. If this parameter is left empty, the default value 8 is used
PostBodySizeLimit.description_zh: Body大小限制，值为数字，单位是KB，支持1～8KB大小的Body，值为空的时候，默认按8KB生效

PostCache.description_en: Specifies whether the POST cache feature is enabled

QueryString.description_en: The query strings to be reserved or excluded. You can specify multiple values separated by spaces
QueryString.description_zh: 需要保留或者删除的查询字符串，支持输入多个值，多个值之间用空格分隔

QueryStringMode.description_en:
The query string processing mode when generating cache keys. Valid values:
ignore_all: Ignore all query strings.
exclude_query_string: Exclude specified query strings.
reserve_all: Reserve all query strings. This is the default value.
include_query_string: Include specified query strings
QueryStringMode.description_zh:
在生成缓存键的时候，对查询字符串的处理模式。取值范围：
ignore_all：全部忽略。
exclude_query_string：删除指定查询字符串。
reserve_all：默认值，全部保留。
include_query_string：保留指定查询字符串
